unit.why: A single narrative: the Apter Rav visits the tsaddeket Miriam, sister of R. Shmelke, and she tells him a wondrous tale about her brother, which moves the whole crowd to tears.

stories.start_quote: ההצה״ק מ׳ יהושע העשיל מאפטא היה בדרך
stories.end_quote: ומי שהיה לו לב אבן נמוח
stories.summary_en: The Apter Rav visits Miriam, sister of R. Shmelke of Nikolsburg, who tells how her sleepless brother's candle went out, a man handed him a lit candle up to the high gallery, and a yihud revealed it was Elijah, sent from heaven, for which R. Shmelke afflicted himself for months; the Apter Rav and all present then weep for repentance.
